Axis Max Life Insurance Limited an Associate of the Bank is holding shares and is shown under "Insurance" Category. Note for Serial No. 63 of the XBRL - The outstanding options are held by the employees of the Bank and its subsidiaries and we have mentioned the same under the category of Resident individuals upto 2 lakhs.
The Bank of New York Mellon is the custodian for Global Despository Receipts issued by the Bank. In terms of the 2nd supplemental agreement amending and restating the Deposit Agreement between the Bank and The Bank of New York Mellon, GDR holders can now vote on the GDRs held by them subject to compliance with Section 12B of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949.
Hence, shown under public shareholding.
